dedupe_keys.name: siradel railway ray tracing mimo channel samples

description: SIRADEL publishes synthetic railway radio-channel samples generated with its InoWave ray-tracing engine. Two CSV files describe 1,900-megahertz propagation along a 60-metre outdoor-to-indoor trajectory at Montparnasse station and a 163-metre urban trajectory in southern Paris. Multipath fields include delays, Doppler shifts, departure and arrival angles, complex amplitudes and vehicle positions; no transmit-power, antenna-pattern or bandwidth response is applied. The June 2026 files are freely downloadable and can benchmark FRMCS communications simulations. Licensing is inconsistent: Zenodo’s licence field says CC BY-SA 4.0, while the detailed description says CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and prohibits commercial use. This conflict remains unresolved. No related catalogue record explicitly covers these samples. The simulations are not field channel measurements, and uncertainty or validation against observations was not independently assessed. Files were not downloaded.
